header.running_head: Leading the Salaah and Following the Imaam During the Time of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: ﷺ said to Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA), "O Abu Sufyaan! Accept Islaam and live in peace." After Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) accepted Islaam, he proceeded with Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) to his camp. The next morning when the Sahabah (RA) rushed to perform wudhu, Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) asked, "What is the matter with the people, O Abul Fadhl? Have they received an order?" "No," replied Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), "they are preparing for salaah." Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) then performed wudhu on the instructions of Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), who then took him to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ started the salaah and when he called out the Takbeer, the Sahabah (RA) followed suit. They all then made Ruku when Rasulullaah ﷺ made Ruku and got up again when Rasulullaah ﷺ got up. To this, Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) remarked, "To this day have I never seen such discipline from a nation who have been gathered together from such varying backgrounds! Neither are the nobles of Persia nor the long-established Romans as well disciplined as this!" Addressing Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), he said further, "O Abul Fadhl! Your nephew has certainly founded a great kingdom." "It is not a kingdom," Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) replied, "This is Nubuwwah." [^1]

Another narration from Hadhrat Maymoona (RA) quoted in the chapter discussing the Conquest of Makkah states that when Rasulullaah ﷺ got up to perform wudhu, the Muslims would compete to get the wudhu water and rub it on their faces. To this, Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) remarked, "O Abul Fadhl! Your nephew has certainly founded a great kingdom." "It is not a kingdom," Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) replied, "This is Nubuwwah and it is this that the people are so zealous about." [^2]

A narration from Hadhrat Urwa (RA) states that when Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) awoke the morning after he had spent the night with Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), he saw the Sahabah (RA) (eagerly) preparing for salaah and scattering about to purify themselves. Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) became alarmed at this sight and asked Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) what the matter was. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) replied, "They have heard the Adhaan and are now scattering about to prepare for salaah." When salaah commenced and Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) saw the Sahabah (RA) bow and prostrate when Rasulullaah ﷺ did so, he remarked, "O Abbaas! Do they do everything he instructs them to do." "Certainly," Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) replied, "they would obey Rasulullaah ﷺ even if he were to command them to forsake their food and drink." [^3]
